task_context.problem_statement: Given the function f(x) defined by the graph of a parabola passing through points (-2, 0), (0, -4), and (2, 0), find the value of f(-1) and f(3).

Puzzle: What are the values of f(-1) and f(3) for a parabola passing through (-2, 0), (0, -4), and (2, 0)? AnswerBot, go!
